text: The JSDoc repair documents abortable with @type rather than treating the getter as a function parameter. The historical private field used an explicit @name to avoid a generator conflict; accepted source instead has #abortController and an abortable accessor typed as nullable AbortController. Follow the property contract and explain its button-state side effect; do not require the historical private-name override after the field has changed. This is static source evidence.
